name: Tiffin Route
summary: A lunch delivery desk for a Karachi home kitchen, where tiffins stack into carriers and routes tick off live
about: An eight-page desk for a home-cooked lunch kitchen in Karachi that sends steel tiffins to five areas every day. Pack an order and its tiffins fly into the rider's carrier and stack up; a full carrier rides away. On the live map the route line turns red as each stop ticks off, and subscribers, the weekly menu, payments in PKR, complaints and reports all work.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Kitchen board, Subscribers, Riders and routes, Menu planner, Payments, Complaints, Reports or Settings
On the kitchen board press Pack on an order, or Pack next, and watch the tiffins stack into the carrier; Send lets the rider leave
Follow a rider on the live map, move stops earlier or later, mark one delivered or re-plan the route
Add, edit, pause or resume subscribers, and drag dishes onto days in the menu planner
Record payments, send reminders, resolve complaints with a credit, and switch reports between 7, 30 and 90 days
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset the demo data or start a new day in Settings
